data.name: Abidat
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Abd’, meaning ‘servant’ or ‘slave’. The suffix ‘at’ denotes a female. Thus, Abidat means ‘Female Servant of Allah’ or ‘Devoted Female Servant of Allah’.
data.spiritual_meaning: A constant reminder of one's devotion and servitude to Allah.
data.numerology_meaning: People with the name Abidat have a strong desire for knowledge and creativity. They are innovative and intuitive, and they often have a deep understanding of the world.
